args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; on-call was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back to 0.002.
